newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Filter Corp to acquire Utility Supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Filter Corp to acquire Utility Supply.

text.p: U.S. Filter Corp said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire The Utility Supply Group Inc of Waco, Texas.

U.S. filter will pay about $22 million in common stock and the assumption of some $24 million in USG debt to pay for the acquisition. U.S. Filter said it expects the deal will be additive to its earnings this fiscal year. USG had revenues for 1995 of some $157 million.
USG is a provider of water and wastewater related products and services to industrial and municipal customers.
Shares of U.S. Filter were 1-5/8 higher at 25-7/8 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
